services.name: Ballet Class
services.desc: In China, Chinese dancers are trained in basic ballet. We offer this same training to our dancers. Students learn and perfect barre work like tondue and center combinations that include chaine turns in the process improving their posture and learning to control their movements. Students who take the class improve

blurb: Ah-Lan Dance Studio provides Chinese dance classes including classical and folk dances, wugong (Chinese acrobatics) classes by instructor invitation, and ballet classes for children and adults. Classes focus on developing well-rounded dancers prepared for stage performances. The studio also offers drop-in fitness and dance classes from various cultures.
extraNote: Contact instructors at least a day prior if unable to attend class · Every dancer is expected to perform unless informed at the beginning of the year · Ah-Lan Dance Studio at 10512 San Pablo Avenue, El Cerrito, CA 94530
